column1: # 13 Sentinels: Aegis Rim (Asia) on Android (keys in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "Game profiles on Android")
# The Asian release (Japanese / Korean / Chinese) of the game the western profile 01003FC01670C000 covers: its own title ID and its own main build (31194702…), the same
# subsdk0 / sdk builds and the same shader keys (all 751 rows), at other offsets in main. The profile is upstream's (seedds/nxnative dm/games/01008D7016438000, played on the Mac:
# 60 fps with sound, saving and loading; no host change was needed); the Android bring-up is ours: the game's own files (the profile's romfs marker is the Chinese data archive
# ROBO_CN.CPK), the gamepad's theme pack is the western release's (the gamepad's layout, the pause menu's settings and the operation mode are the western profile's, so the two
# releases play the same way). On the Xiaomi 23117RK66C (Snapdragon 8 Gen 3, Adreno 750, Android 16): the port runs, the game starts, the Chinese text and the cutscenes play, the
# save menu works, 58-59 fps at 1440p with 1.4 GB resident.

column2: base game 1.00 · 60 fps · the Asian release (Japanese, Korean, Chinese) · tested on the Xiaomi 23117RK66C (Android 16)
